extracted.name: Aguas Frescas Recipe
extracted.description: Learn how to make aguas frescas! These refreshing drinks are easy to make with water, fresh fruit, lime juice, and a little sweetener. They're one of my favorite ways to cool off on a hot summer day!
ingredient_lines: 1 cup chopped fresh fruit (such as watermelon, cantaloupe or other melon, mango, pineapple, strawberries or even cucumber)
2 teaspoons agave nectar or sugar (plus more to taste (I often add another teaspoon depending on the fruit))
instruction_lines: In a blender, place the fruit, water, lime juice, and 2 teaspoons agave. Blend until smooth, then taste, adding more agave if desired.
Set a fine mesh strainer over a large jar or medium bowl and pour the agua fresca through it to remove the fruit pulp.
Pour into a glass with ice and garnish with fruit and mint leaves, if desired.
